faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Palo Alto?
faq.answer: Palo Alto homeowners typically invest $10,000 to $25,000 for a full window replacement project. This world-famous Silicon Valley city — with median home values exceeding $3 million — features original Eichler flats, Craftsman homes near University Avenue, and custom estate homes in Crescent Park and Old Palo Alto. Large Eichler floor-to-ceiling glass systems require specialized installation. Single window installation starts at approximately $750.

faq.question: Do I need a permit for window replacement in Palo Alto?
faq.answer: Yes. Palo Alto requires a building permit for window replacements. Eichler homes and properties in Old Palo Alto's historic residential areas may require additional design review to ensure replacement windows respect the architectural character of the home. Our team manages all Palo Alto permit applications on your behalf.

faq.question: Which window brands does Deluxe Windows install in Palo Alto?
faq.answer: Palo Alto's tech-savvy, design-conscious market demands the best. We most frequently install Andersen 400-Series for Eichlers and Craftsman homes, Marvin Ultimate for Old Palo Alto estates requiring premium wood-clad aesthetics, and Western Window Systems for modernist homes seeking large sliding glass door systems.

faq.question: Does Deluxe Windows serve all Palo Alto neighborhoods?
faq.answer: Yes — we serve all Palo Alto neighborhoods including Crescent Park, Old Palo Alto, Professorville, Barron Park, Midtown, and South Palo Alto. Zip codes: 94301, 94303, 94304, 94306.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Palo Alto?
faq.answer: Most Palo Alto projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once windows arrive, typically four to eight weeks after ordering.
